title: NileChat: Towards Linguistically Diverse and Culturally Aware LLMs for Local Communities

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model alignment with local societal values using multiple-choice questions adapted from the World Values Survey (WVS) via the Social Value Alignment (SVA) metric, and assessing local cultural knowledge using the Palm benchmark with an LLM-as-judge.

Measuring language understanding and translation capabilities in low-resource dialects (Egyptian and Moroccan Arabic) using dialect-adapted benchmarks (MMLU, HellaSwag, Belebele) and translation datasets (Flores-200, in-house TV transcripts) to counter the dominance of high-resource languages.
